### Unum Group Declares Quarterly Dividend of $0.505 Per Share of Its Common Stock


October 15, 2026


CHATTANOOGA, Tenn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Effective October 15, 2026, the Unum Group (NYSE: UNM) Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.505 per share on its common stock to be paid November 20, 2026, to stockholders of record as of October 30, 2026.


**About Unum Group**


[Unum Group](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.unumgroup.com%2F&esheet=54622801&newsitemid=20261015180644&lan=en-US&anchor=Unum+Group&index=1&md5=128c1d4ccd90c49c011b141f3159d73e) (NYSE: UNM), a leading international provider of workplace benefits and services, has been helping workers and their families thrive for more than 175 years. Through its Unum and Colonial Life brands, the company offers disability, life, accident, critical illness, dental, and vision insurance; leave and absence management support; and behavioral health services. In 2025, Unum Group reported revenues of $13.1 billion and paid $8.3 billion in benefits. The Fortune 500 company is recognized as one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies by Ethisphere®.
